findings.issue: Shadow-fonts rendered too thin/outlined and weakened Darius' humiliation-to-hatred threat sequence compared with the source bubble acting.
findings.repair: Use Mac-dinh-3 for the full threat run and carry emotion through size/wording rather than an unrelated display face.

findings.issue: Curves-Regular rendered too narrow/decorative, reducing readability and drifting from the source's clean handwritten/bold narration language.
findings.repair: Use Mac-dinh-3 for mythic bubble recollection and Mac-dinh-2 for lyrical narration boxes.

findings.issue: Two narration objects switched to BeVietnamPro only because Mac-dinh-2/Mac-dinh-3 did not contain U+2014 EM DASH, causing an obvious font jump.
findings.repair: Make two local punctuation edits that preserve scene continuity without the unsupported em dash, keeping the intended chapter font family.

findings.issue: Shadow-fonts made the final revelation look light and decorative instead of weighty; the source keeps the same dialogue family with stronger emphasis.
findings.repair: Use bold Mac-dinh-3 at the largest fitting size.

findings.issue: Renderer measured line width as bbox[2] instead of bbox[2]-bbox[0], so fonts with non-zero left bearing could occasionally look pushed to one side even when center alignment was requested.
findings.repair: Use visible ink bounds for fit/wrap/alignment and compensate font left bearing; retain human bubble-by-bubble visual review for asymmetric bubble geometry.

findings.issue: The panic bubble on clean_002_00.png still contained source fragments 'I' and 'IT!' outside the detector-owned text region, which became visible beside the Vietnamese render.
findings.repair: Apply a local white-bubble cleanup to only the two residual source-text rectangles before rerendering; do not rerun inpaint for the chapter.
